==Hero Usage==
* While the Glyph is active, the [[AI]] prioritizes skill usage based on energy costs. Consequently, be careful in crafting hero skill bars that make use of this skill.
** For example, [[Monk]]s are more likely to cast [[Healing Seed]] (cost: 10{{energy}}) before [[Healing Light]] (cost: 5{{energy}}) on a near-death ally.

== Notes ==
* Charges are used up if the spell is [[cancel]]led or [[interrupt]]ed while being cast.
** However, charges will not be used if a spell fails due to its target dying while the spell is being cast.

== Trivia ==
* Before [[game updates/20080306|March 6th, 2008]], cancelled spells did not use up a charge.
